thread:
alex: Heads up — after the org-mapping PR merged a few mins ago, I'm seeing KMS decrypts for org-B resources initiated by a service account tied to org-A. Not sure if alias fallback kicked in.
emma-security: Which PR/commit? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/492
sara: I can see the spike in decrypts and a mix of 200/500 responses. Sample logs: `decrypt key=alias/redwood-org-b user=svc-org-a request_id=ck_abc123`
infra-bot: deploy complete: infra/main @ 492 merged by alex — 2777770000
mike: If that's true, this is cross-org access. Immediate risk: unauthorized access to customer key materials. Please treat as Sev2 until proven otherwise.
emma-security: Hypothesis: the org->workspace remap introduced an alias collision. The resolver changed ordering so ambiguous aliases are resolved to first match, and org-A and org-B share a short alias.
alex: Can we rollback PR 492 now? Or apply a temporary denial in the KMS resolver?
sara: Rolling back immediately is safest. But we can also flip resolver to deny-ambiguous. Quick mitigation command: `kubectl exec -n infra resolver -- curl -XPOST localhost:8080/flags -d '{"deny_ambiguous_alias":true}'`
mike: I've filed an incident: INC-8712 and pinged infra oncall.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-8712 created — Sev 2 — cross-org KMS access observed. Assigned: emma-security, alex — 2777770018
emma-security: I'm working on a hotfix to force explicit org-prefix matching before alias fallback. Will also enable verbose audit on the resolver and KMS proxy.
alex: Hotfix PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/495 — adds org-prefix check and extra audit fields (org_id, resolved_alias, resolver_path)
sara: Patching prod now. Applying flag and deploying PR 495 to canary.
sara: Canary results: no cross-org decrypts for 3m, resolving requests now include `resolved_org` in logs.
emma-security: Requesting full audit export for the last 24h to validate no successful decrypts for mismatched orgs. Data team ticket #DATA-223 created.
mike: Post-mitigation actions: 1) full audit export + validation, 2) force key rotation for impacted aliases, 3) add unit + integration tests for alias collisions, 4) alert on per-org KMS-decrypt anomaly.
alex: Also add a canary that fails if any `resolved_org != request_org` hits prod paths.
emma-security: Agreed. Marking incident as "mitigated" pending audit confirmation. I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups. Thanks all for quick response.
infra-bot: rollback window expired; auto-rollback not needed (no rollback executed) — 2777770060
